mapper.sql: select id, task_no, order_number, task_source, submit_person, customer_name, company_name, company_id, tax_number, task_type, effective_date, end_date, product_names, company_type, accounting_standard, province, current_step, status, illustrate, create_time, update_time from task
mapper.select:
select t.id, t.task_no, t.order_number, t.task_source, t1.real_name as submit_person, t.customer_name, t.company_name, t.company_id, t.tax_number, t.task_type, t.effective_date, t.end_date, t.product_names, t.company_type, t.accounting_standard, t.province, t.current_step, t.status, t.illustrate, t.create_time, t.update_time from task t left join sys_user t1 on t.submit_person = t1.username where t.id = #{id}
and t.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: insert into task ( tenant_id, task_no, order_number, task_source, submit_person, customer_name, company_name, company_id, tax_number, task_type, effective_date, end_date, product_names, company_type, accounting_standard, province, current_step, status, illustrate, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{taskNo}, #{orderNumber}, #{taskSource}, #{submitPerson}, #{customerName}, #{companyName}, #{companyId}, #{taxNumber}, #{taskType}, #{effectiveDate}, #{endDate}, #{productNames}, #{companyType}, #{accountingStandard}, #{province}, #{currentStep}, #{status}, #{illustrate}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update task set status = #{status}, current_step = #{currentStep}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
